mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Polarized Fractal Efficiency zero crossing identifies a reversal in the direction of efficient versus circuitous price travel; follow the new sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when smoothed PFE crosses strictly above zero; short when it crosses strictly below zero
mechanism.why_distinct: PFE signs the Euclidean straight-line displacement over ten completed segments and divides it by the sum of every segment's Euclidean path length, then applies a fixed EMA(5). It is not raw momentum sums, regression, price-average crossover, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour signed path-efficiency zero crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.straight_distance: sqrt((current close-close ten completed bars earlier)^2+100)
features.path_distance: sum over the same ten segments of sqrt((one-bar close change)^2+1)
features.raw_pfe: 100*straight/path with sign of net close displacement, strict positive path and nonzero displacement
features.pfe: causal EMA(5) of raw PFE, reset across source gaps and emitted after full warmup
features.event: current completed PFE strictly crosses above zero from <=0 or below zero from >=0
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical PFE(10,5) zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no efficiency length, smoothing, geometry, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Hans Hannula canonical Polarized Fractal Efficiency convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: over 10 completed price segments, numerator=sqrt((close-close_lag10)^2+10^2), denominator=sum sqrt((one-step close change)^2+1), ratio times 100 signed by net displacement, then EMA(5)
external_basis.selection_use: published default length 10, EMA smoothing 5, and zero-line direction only; no incidence or outcomes
